senses.meaning: Giải phẫu học; cấu tạo cơ thể
examples: Physiology and anatomy are basic to medical science.
The book includes detailed diagrams of human anatomy.
She studied the anatomy of the hand before sculpting it.

senses.meaning: Bệnh tật, sự đau ốm (thường dùng trong văn viết)
examples: Malaria is a serious malady affecting millions.
He was determined not to yield to the malady.
The film explores the social malady of addiction.

senses.meaning: Vết bầm tím
examples: He had a bruise just below his right eye.
She had a whopping great bruise on her arm.
The bruise took two weeks to fade completely.

senses.meaning: Làm bầm tím; gây tổn thương
examples: She bruised her knee badly when she fell.
Don't drop the peaches — they bruise easily.
The fall bruised two of his ribs.

senses.meaning: Sự vỡ, đứt (mạch máu, ống, cơ quan nội tạng)
examples: The rupture of a blood vessel usually causes a bruise.
He suffered a rupture of his Achilles tendon.
A pipe rupture flooded the basement.

senses.meaning: Vỡ ra, đứt; làm vỡ
examples: The blood vessel ruptured under pressure.
Her appendix ruptured and required emergency surgery.
The pipe ruptured during the cold snap.

senses.meaning: Lâm sàng; lạnh lùng, không cảm xúc
examples: Clinical trials of the new drug may take five years.
He practises as a clinical psychologist.
Her manner was professional but almost clinical.

senses.meaning: Thương vong; phòng cấp cứu (tiếng Anh Anh)
examples: He was admitted to casualty with head injuries.
The earthquake caused heavy casualties.
Small shops have been a casualty of the recession.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh: 'casualty' = phòng cấp cứu (= A&E = Accident & Emergency). Tiếng Anh Mỹ: 'emergency room' (ER).

senses.meaning: Không thể chữa khỏi
examples: She was diagnosed with a rare, incurable disease.
Parkinson's disease is a debilitating and incurable condition.
He was an incurable optimist who never lost faith.

senses.meaning: Bệnh tiểu đường (đái tháo đường)
examples: Diabetes is a chronic condition affecting millions worldwide.
Type 2 diabetes is closely linked to obesity and inactivity.
He was diagnosed with diabetes at the age of forty.

senses.meaning: Gãy xương, vết nứt
examples: She suffered a fracture of the left wrist.
A stress fracture forced the athlete to withdraw from the race.
The X-ray revealed a hairline fracture.

senses.meaning: Làm gãy, bị gãy
examples: He fractured his wrist in the fall.
The impact fractured two of his ribs.
The force of the collision fractured the skull.

senses.meaning: Sự cắt cụt chi
examples: The infection was so severe that amputation was necessary.
He learned to walk again with a prosthesis after the amputation.
Modern prosthetics have greatly improved life after amputation.

senses.meaning: Chuyển hoá (thực phẩm, chất trong cơ thể)
examples: We metabolize alcohol at different rates.
The body metabolizes food into energy.
These compounds are metabolized by enzymes in the liver.

senses.meaning: Dị ứng
examples: She is allergic to peanuts.
He had an allergic reaction to the medication.
Allergic symptoms include sneezing, itching, and swelling.

senses.meaning: Giảm đau
examples: The doctor prescribed a pain-relieving medication.
Aspirin has well-known pain-relieving properties.
Pain-relieving creams can be applied directly to the affected area.

senses.meaning: Mô (sinh học); khăn giấy
examples: The disease attacks the brain tissue.
Muscle tissue repairs itself over time.
She handed him a tissue to wipe his tears.

senses.meaning: Béo phì (mức độ thừa cân nghiêm trọng về mặt y tế)
examples: She is grossly obese and has been advised to change her diet.
Obese patients are at higher risk of cardiovascular disease.
Being obese significantly reduces life expectancy.

senses.meaning: Tuyến tụy
examples: The pancreas produces insulin to regulate blood sugar.
Cancer of the pancreas is difficult to detect early.
The pancreas plays a key role in digestion.

senses.meaning: Tiền đái tháo đường
examples: Prediabetes can be reversed with lifestyle changes.
He was warned that prediabetes could develop into type 2 diabetes.
Regular exercise and a healthy diet help manage prediabetes.

senses.meaning: Một cách mãn tính, dai dẳng, thường xuyên
examples: The hospital is chronically underfunded.
She has been chronically ill for years.
The region is chronically short of clean water.

senses.meaning: Rối loạn cương dương
examples: Erectile dysfunction becomes more common with age.
Medications for erectile dysfunction have become widely available.
Stress and anxiety are common contributing factors to erectile dysfunction.

senses.meaning: Chứng hoang tưởng; nỗi sợ quá mức
examples: His paranoia made him suspicious of everyone around him.
The dictator's paranoia led to mass arrests.
There is growing paranoia about data privacy online.

senses.meaning: Thuộc phẫu thuật; chính xác, dứt khoát
examples: All surgical instruments must be sterilised before use.
A biopsy is usually a minor surgical procedure.
The military carried out a surgical strike on the facility.

senses.meaning: Sinh thiết (lấy mô để xét nghiệm)
examples: The biopsy confirmed it was a benign tumour.
A biopsy was taken from the suspicious tissue.
The results of the biopsy will be ready in a week.

senses.meaning: Quá liều (thuốc hoặc chất gây nghiện)
examples: She took an overdose of paracetamol.
When he was 17 he took an overdose of sleeping pills and nearly died.
A heroin overdose can be fatal within minutes.

senses.meaning: Dùng quá liều
examples: He overdosed on painkillers and was rushed to hospital.
She overdosed and barely survived.
He had overdosed on heroin three times before.

senses.meaning: Phương thuốc, cách chữa trị; sự chữa khỏi
examples: There is still no cure for AIDS.
Sleep is the best cure for many ailments.
The cure proved worse than the disease.

senses.meaning: Chữa khỏi, điều trị khỏi
examples: The treatment cured her infection within a week.
He needed surgery to cure a troublesome back injury.
There is no drug that can cure this condition.

senses.meaning: Tình trạng sức khoẻ, phong độ
examples: I feel in fine fettle after my two weeks' holiday.
The team is in fine fettle ahead of the tournament.
The good news put her in fine fettle.

note: Chủ yếu dùng trong cụm 'in fine fettle' = trong trạng thái sức khoẻ tốt.

senses.meaning: Sự bất lực; chứng rối loạn cương dương
examples: He felt a sense of impotence in the face of such injustice.
Impotence can have both physical and psychological causes.
The government's impotence in the crisis was exposed.

senses.meaning: Chóng mặt, hoa mắt
examples: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy.
She stood up too quickly and felt dizzy.
The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.

senses.meaning: Triệu chứng (bệnh); dấu hiệu (của vấn đề lớn hơn)
examples: The first symptom of the disease is a high temperature.
The disappearance of jobs is a symptom of deeper economic change.
Fatigue is a common symptom of anaemia.

senses.meaning: Sức khoẻ và hạnh phúc tổng thể
examples: She was filled with a sense of well-being.
The school prioritises the emotional well-being of its pupils.
Exercise has a positive effect on mental well-being.

senses.meaning: Chẩn đoán
examples: The diagnosis was devastating — she had cancer.
Further tests have confirmed the diagnosis.
Early diagnosis is critical for successful treatment.

senses.meaning: Thuộc tim mạch
examples: Cardiovascular disease is a leading cause of death worldwide.
Regular exercise improves cardiovascular health.
He was referred to a cardiovascular specialist.

senses.meaning: Viêm, sưng tấy
examples: The drug reduces inflammation and pain.
Chronic inflammation can lead to serious health problems.
Ice helps reduce inflammation after an injury.

senses.meaning: Thụ thể (phân tử trên tế bào nhận tín hiệu hoá học)
examples: The drug binds to receptors in the brain.
Pain receptors send signals to the nervous system.
Researchers identified a new type of receptor linked to appetite.

senses.meaning: Nhiễm trùng, sự lây nhiễm
examples: The wound became red — a sign of infection.
Antibiotics are used to treat bacterial infections.
Good hygiene helps prevent the spread of infection.

senses.meaning: Co giật, cơn động kinh
examples: A sudden convulsion shook him and he fell to the ground.
The child had a convulsion caused by high fever.
She was taken to hospital after suffering convulsions.

senses.meaning: Vết loét, vết thương hở trên da
examples: She had a sore on her lip that kept coming back.
Prolonged bed rest can cause pressure sores.
The sore took several weeks to heal.

senses.meaning: Đau, nhức; bực bội (nghĩa bóng)
examples: My throat is sore and it hurts to swallow.
His muscles were sore after the long run.
She was still sore about losing the promotion.

senses.meaning: Chứng mất ngủ
examples: Stress is a common cause of insomnia.
She has suffered from insomnia for years.
Insomnia can have serious effects on mental health and concentration.

senses.meaning: Mãn tính, kinh niên (kéo dài lâu hoặc tái phát thường xuyên)
examples: He was suffering from chronic bronchitis.
There is a chronic shortage of affordable housing.
Chronic pain can affect every aspect of daily life.

note: Phân biệt: chronic (mãn tính, kéo dài) vs acute (cấp tính, dữ dội trong thời gian ngắn).

senses.meaning: Sưng lên, phồng lên; tăng lên về quy mô
examples: Her ankle swelled badly after the sprain.
The seeds will swell when immersed in water.
The ranks of the unemployed swelled during the recession.

senses.meaning: Về mặt lâm sàng, theo tiêu chuẩn y khoa
examples: Doctors declared her clinically brain-dead.
The treatment has been clinically proven to reduce symptoms.
He was clinically depressed and needed immediate intervention.

senses.meaning: Chẩn đoán
examples: The doctor diagnosed him with pneumonia.
The condition was diagnosed too late for effective treatment.
She was diagnosed with cancer at the age of thirty.

senses.meaning: Tỷ lệ mắc phải, tần suất xảy ra
examples: There is still a high incidence of malaria in the area.
Why did the incidence of heroin use continue to climb?
The incidence of childhood obesity has doubled in two decades.

senses.meaning: Phân loại bệnh nhân theo mức độ ưu tiên cấp cứu
examples: The nurse performed triage on the incoming patients.
The triage system ensures those most at risk are treated first.
In a mass casualty event, effective triage saves lives.

senses.meaning: Trẻ sinh đôi; vật/người giống hệt
examples: My twin sister and I have the same nose.
Can you tell her from her twin?
The two towns are described as twins — similar in almost every way.

senses.meaning: Sinh đôi; đôi, thành cặp giống nhau
examples: She gave birth to twin boys.
The hotel offers twin rooms with two single beds.
The twin towers were visible from miles away.

senses.meaning: Ca cấy ghép; cơ quan được cấy ghép
examples: His only chance of survival was a heart transplant.
Several of the patients had received kidney transplants.
The transplant was a success and she recovered fully.

senses.meaning: Cấy ghép; cấy (cây); chuyển đến nơi mới
examples: The surgeon transplanted a healthy kidney into the patient.
The seedlings were transplanted into the garden after the last frost.
His family was transplanted from the countryside to the city.

senses.meaning: Vô sinh; cằn cỗi (đất đai)
examples: Thousands of women are infertile as a result of complications.
The soil proved too infertile to sustain crops.
He was told he was infertile after a series of tests.

senses.meaning: Thuốc trị bách bệnh (nghĩa bóng: giải pháp vạn năng)
examples: There is no panacea for the country's economic problems.
Technology is not a panacea for all social ills.
He viewed education as the panacea for poverty.

senses.meaning: Dược sĩ
examples: Ask your pharmacist for advice on over-the-counter medicines.
The pharmacist checked for potential drug interactions.
She trained as a pharmacist before switching to research.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh cũng dùng 'chemist' cho dược sĩ và hiệu thuốc.

senses.meaning: Bệnh dịch (đặc biệt là dịch hạch); tai họa, nạn dịch
examples: The plague swept through Europe in the 14th century.
The city is under threat from a plague of rats.
Corruption is the plague of modern governance.

senses.meaning: Gây phiền não, quấy rầy liên tục
examples: Financial problems have plagued the company for years.
The region has been plagued by drought.
He was plagued by self-doubt throughout his career.

senses.meaning: Kê đơn thuốc; quy định chính thức
examples: Ask the doctor to prescribe something for that cough.
If these don't work, I may have to prescribe you something stronger.
The law prescribes a maximum sentence of ten years.

senses.meaning: Dịch bệnh; vấn đề lan rộng như dịch
examples: The epidemic spread rapidly across three continents.
Authorities declared an epidemic after hundreds fell ill.
Obesity is sometimes described as an epidemic in modern society.

note: Phân biệt: epidemic (bùng phát trong một khu vực), pandemic (lan ra toàn cầu).

senses.meaning: Chuột rút, co cứng cơ đau đớn
examples: He got a cramp in his calf during the marathon.
Swimming on a full stomach can cause cramps.
She was doubled over with stomach cramps.

senses.meaning: Gây chuột rút; hạn chế, cản trở
examples: Cold water cramped his legs during the swim.
Long-haul flights cramp your muscles if you don't move around.
Lack of funding is cramping their research.

senses.meaning: Bệnh tả (do vi khuẩn, lây qua nguồn nước ô nhiễm)
examples: Cholera outbreaks are common in areas with poor sanitation.
The village was devastated by a cholera epidemic.
Access to clean water is the most effective way to prevent cholera.

senses.meaning: Nôn ra, trào ngược; lặp lại một cách thụ động (nghĩa bóng)
examples: Some birds regurgitate food to feed their young.
The patient regurgitated everything she had eaten.
Students should learn to think critically, not just regurgitate facts.

senses.meaning: Ọe, buồn nôn (cố gắng nôn nhưng không ra)
examples: The smell made her retch.
He retched but nothing came up.
The sight of the wound caused him to retch.

senses.meaning: Sự teo cơ, thoái hoá; sự suy giảm dần
examples: Muscle atrophy occurs after prolonged bed rest.
The local economy suffered atrophy as young people left.
Without stimulus, skills fade through atrophy.

senses.meaning: Teo lại, suy thoái, mất dần
examples: Without exercise, muscles will begin to atrophy.
The industry has atrophied due to lack of investment.
Her talent began to atrophy from years of inactivity.

senses.meaning: Bệnh béo phì
examples: Obesity increases the risk of diabetes and heart disease.
Childhood obesity is a growing public health concern.
A combination of diet and exercise can help combat obesity.

senses.meaning: Sự bùng phát (dịch bệnh, bạo lực)
examples: An outbreak of measles affected dozens of children.
The outbreak was traced to contaminated food.
Quick action contained the outbreak before it spread further.

senses.meaning: Buồng trứng
examples: Ovarian cancer is one of the most difficult to diagnose early.
The ovary produces hormones essential to the reproductive cycle.
She underwent surgery to remove a cyst on her ovary.

senses.meaning: Chất nhầy (do niêm mạc tiết ra)
examples: Excess mucus production is a symptom of many respiratory conditions.
The throat produces mucus to trap dust and pathogens.
The medication helped reduce mucus build-up in the airways.

note: Tính từ liên quan: mucous (như 'mucous membrane' — niêm mạc).

senses.meaning: Vết trầy xước
examples: The child had minor abrasions on her knees from the fall.
He suffered abrasions to his hands after sliding on the pavement.
Abrasions should be cleaned and covered to prevent infection.

senses.meaning: Băng (vết thương), dải băng y tế
examples: The nurse applied a fresh bandage to the wound.
Change the bandage every twenty-four hours.
He wrapped a bandage around his sprained ankle.

senses.meaning: Băng bó, quấn băng
examples: The nurse bandaged his wound carefully.
She bandaged her twisted ankle before the hike.
He bandaged the cut to stop the bleeding.

senses.meaning: Động mạch; trục giao thông chính (nghĩa bóng)
examples: The knife severed an artery and he bled to death.
A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
The motorway is one of the main arteries into the capital.

senses.meaning: Thuộc phổi
examples: A blockage in the pulmonary artery can be life-threatening.
He has been suffering from pulmonary tuberculosis for several years.
Pulmonary rehabilitation helps patients with lung disease.

senses.meaning: Bệnh lao (do vi khuẩn Mycobacterium tuberculosis)
examples: He has been suffering from pulmonary tuberculosis for several years.
Tuberculosis can be reactivated in people with weakened immune systems.
The BCG vaccine provides some protection against tuberculosis.

senses.meaning: Tuổi thọ cao; sự tồn tại lâu dài
examples: A healthy lifestyle is strongly linked to longevity.
Good habits promote longevity.
The longevity of the company is a testament to sound management.

senses.meaning: Sự trẻ hóa, làm tươi mới lại
examples: The spa offers a range of rejuvenation treatments.
Urban rejuvenation projects transformed the derelict docklands.
A holiday can provide both physical and mental rejuvenation.

senses.meaning: Thuộc hệ tuần hoàn máu
examples: Diabetes can cause serious circulatory problems.
Diseases of the circulatory system are among the leading causes of death.
Exercise strengthens the heart and improves circulatory health.

senses.meaning: Linh trưởng (bộ động vật có vú bao gồm người, khỉ, vượn)
examples: Chimpanzees and gorillas are primates.
Humans are classified as primates.
Research on primates has contributed greatly to medical science.

senses.meaning: Lượng hấp thụ, lượng nạp vào; số lượng tiếp nhận
examples: She was advised to reduce her daily intake of salt.
A high calorie intake without exercise leads to weight gain.
The hospital's patient intake doubled during the outbreak.

senses.meaning: Ít vận động, ngồi nhiều; định cư một chỗ
examples: A sedentary job combined with poor diet increases cardiovascular risk.
Studies show that sedentary behaviour is linked to depression.
Breaking up sedentary time with short walks improves metabolic health.

senses.meaning: Chất phụ gia (thêm vào thực phẩm hoặc sản phẩm)
examples: Some parents restrict food additives in their children's diets.
The additive was found to cause adverse reactions in sensitive individuals.
All food additives must be listed on the product label.
